newsitem.title: GERMANY: No comment on agenda at EMI council meeting.
newsitem.headline: No comment on agenda at EMI council meeting.

text.p: The regular meeting of the European Monetary Institute Council began at around 0730 GMT on Tuesday at the EMI headquarters in Frankfurt, an EMI spokeswoman said.
The EMI did not comment on the agenda for the meeting and said that no speech would be released afterwards.
The meeting, held once a month, is attended by the 15 governors of European Union central banks and EMI president Alexandre Lamfalussy.
The meeting will be addressed by the Irish finance minister Ruairi Quinn. Ireland currently holds the presidency of the European Union.
The EMI, the forerunner of the future European Central Bank, is responsible for preparations for the third stage of Economic and Monetary Union.
The meetings generally end in the late afternoon.
